reference: In My Name, calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
hyps: In My Name calling aloud in the kingdom of Utterance
In My Name, which calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name that crieth aloud in the kingdom of utterance!
In My Name, Who crieth out in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name which crieth out in the kingdom of Utterance
In My Name that calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance
In My Name calling aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance.
In My Name that calleth aloud in the Kingdom of Utterance.

source: حمد و ثنا سلطان مبین را لایق و سزاست که سجن متین را بحضور حضرت علیّ قبل اکبر و حضرت امین مزیّن فرمود و بانوار ایقان و استقامت و اطمینان مزیّن داشت.
reference: Praise and thanksgiving beseem the Lord of manifest dominion Who hath adorned the mighty prison with the presence of their honors 'Alí-Akbar and Amín, and hath illumined it with the light of certitude, constancy and assurance.
hyps: All praise be unto God, the Lord of manifest sovereignty, Who, at the time of Our arrival, had adorned the strong castle of chains with the company of the Chief of Martyrs, of whom it was said, 'O Ali of Ali's,' and the Bábí Chief, Amín.

Praise to Him Who is the King of men, the Perspicuous Lord, for He hath beautified the strong prison with the presence of Ali Akbar and of Amín, and adorned it with the splendors of faith, steadfastness and certainty.

Praise and thanksgiving be unto the sovereign of the Perspicuous King for He hath beautified the strong prison with the presence of 'Alí-Akbar and Amín. and adorned it with the beams of certitude, constancy, and assurance.

Praise and thanksgiving be to God, the Perspicuous King, Who hath adorned this mighty Prison with the presence of His Highness 'Alí-Akbar and His Highness Amín, and embellished it with the lights of assurance, fidelity, and confidence.

Praise be unto the All-Glorious, the sovereign Lord of all men, Who hath adorned this Most Firm Prison with the presence of Ali-Muhammad, the Chief of Martyrs, and of Amín, and hath shed thereon the radiance of assurance, of constancy and of steadfast belief.

Praise and honor be to the Lord of manifest dominion who hath made this mighty Prison an ornament to the presence of 'Alí-Akbar and Amín and hath illumined it with the brightness of certitude and resolution and confidence.

Praise be unto the sovereign and most visible Lord Who hath adorned this mighty Prison with the countenance of His most mighty champion 'Alí-Akbar and of Amín, and hath embellished it with the bright lamps of certitude, uprightness and confidence.

Praise and thanksgiving beseem the King of manifest power, who hath adorned His mighty prison with the presence of the Most Noble 'Alí-Akbar and of the Trusted One Amín, who hath illumined it with the splendor of faith and steadfastness and assurance.
